Coram : D.K. JAIN*, A.K. PATNAIK
KERALA LAND REFORMS ACT, 1963: c s.51, proviso - Surrender by tenant of his interests in the leasehold land to landlord - HELD: Being in contravention of s. 51, was void. ss. 13-A and 125 - Restoration of possession of tenants dispossessed after 1.4.1964 - Jurisdiction of civil court - D Held: by a tenant is neither barred expressly nor impliedly bys. 13-A - Further, s.125 makes it clear that in any suit regarding rights of a tenant the issues of rights of tenant and whether a person is tenant will have to be referred to the civil court. E 'MS', the owner of the suit property
Decision Date : 27-10-2010 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) No. 15221/2007 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
